title: Telemetry, PII, and Export-Control Clarifications for Private Deployment PRD
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Align cross-functional teams on what telemetry is permissible for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, define PII handling boundaries, and capture export-control implications in the PRD. Background: The Private PRD (Confluence: /private-deploy/prd-v2) currently lists 'usage telemetry' as optional but lacks precise definitions that engineering, legal, and design can implement and sign off on. Unclear areas include: 1) whether any hashed identifiers or derived features can be sent to Redwood-hosted analytics endpoints; 2) acceptable retention windows for aggregated performance metrics; 3) required in-client toggles and UI language for customers; 4) whether model metadata or quantized weights can be uploaded for support/diagnostics and the export-control pathway for that asset. This ticket coordinates necessary clarifications, records decisions, and attaches acceptance criteria for sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: Legal confirms list of allowed telemetry fields (no raw PII) and signs off on data flows documented in PRD
Engineering provides a telemetry schema and an opt-in implementation plan for VPC/on-prem that does not send PII to hosted endpoints
Design delivers final copy for the console toggle and consent microcopy; copy is included in PRD and reviewed by Legal
Export-control assessment completed for any diagnostic uploads (model metadata or weights); mitigation steps documented if needed
Security & Compliance confirms retention/aggregation settings and logs any required audit changes

Open questions: 1) Should we support customer-managed endpoints for telemetry ingestion (adds complexity but reduces legal exposure)? 2) Do we need per-region data residency toggles in the initial private launch? Logged these for decision in 2026-03-15 cross-functional review.
decisions: Agreement 2026-03-09: Default telemetry for Private deploys is OFF; customers must opt in via console toggle
Agreement 2026-03-10: No raw text or identifiers are allowed to leave the customer's network. 'Anonymized_event_tags' must be proven non-reversible before Legal final sign-off
Action 2026-03-11: Engineering to provide export-control asset classification for any uploaded diagnostic artifacts; Legal to document mitigation steps
